ai_summary: Asahi Songwon Colors Limited has notified shareholders and exchanges about its 36th Annual General Meeting (AGM) scheduled virtually for September 30, 2026, along with the online availability of the FY 2025-26 Annual Report. The Board recommended a dividend of Rs. 1.50 per equity share, pending AGM approval, impacting shareholders who must ensure KYC compliance and updated email addresses for electronic dividend receipt. This standard regulatory disclosure details routine corporate actions and encourages digital shareholder engagement, with no immediate red flags identified.
